items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When people say “Van Gogh” or “The Rorschach Test,” I wanted to know what they were talking about.

ctx.x: Did you have any professional goals in the field of psychology?
Not particularly. I just wanted to be knowledgeable. When people say “Van Gogh” or “The Rorschach Test,” I wanted to know what they were talking about.
How long did you study at the University of Chicago?
